title: 실제 행동 · 공간이 달라도 남는 판단
titleEn: Decisions that remain across different spaces

paragraphs.ko: 같은 두 번째 작품의 다른 전투를 보겠습니다. 바닥에 놓인 장치 너머에서 적이 다가오고, 플레이어는 겨누는 방향을 바꾸며 직접 공격합니다. 배치 뒤에도 판단이 끝난 것은 아니라는 점을 보세요.
paragraphs.en: Let us look at another battle in the same second game. Enemies approach beyond the devices on the floor, and the player changes their aim and attacks directly. Notice that decisions continue after the devices have been placed.
paragraphs.claim: Placed devices and player aiming coexist; preparation does not remove the visible need to aim at incoming enemies.
paragraphs.viewerFocus: Look from the installed floor devices to the incoming group, then follow the player's aiming direction.

paragraphs.ko: 적이 가까워진 구간에서는 장치 곁을 옮겨 다니며 공격하고, 다른 구간에서는 더 먼 길을 겨눕니다. 여기서 확인한 차이는 거리와 위치입니다. 특정 무기의 피해량이나 최적 전략을 정한 것은 아닙니다.
paragraphs.en: When enemies are closer, the player moves beside the devices and attacks; in another interval, they aim farther down the route. The differences we can observe here are distance and position. This does not establish a weapon's damage or an optimal strategy.
paragraphs.claim: Separate observed intervals illustrate how aiming distance and player position can change around the same prepare/fight activity.
paragraphs.viewerFocus: Compare the nearby group with the farther route across the devices; keep the source intervals separate.

paragraphs.ko: 또 다른 구간에서는 플레이어 바로 옆까지 온 적에게 몸을 돌려 공격하고, 다시 장치 너머의 길을 겨눕니다. 화면에서 지킬 위치와 직접 상대할 대상을 바꾸는 행동을 구별할 수 있습니다.
paragraphs.en: In another interval, the player turns to attack an enemy that has come right beside them, then aims beyond the devices again. We can distinguish changes in the position being defended and the target the player faces directly.
paragraphs.claim: The nearby enemy at1174–1176 and the later distant aim are observed actions; no hidden aggro or universal defence rule is claimed.
paragraphs.viewerFocus: Follow the turn toward the close orc, then the return of the aim toward the device route.

paragraphs.ko: 이 비교는 모두 두 번째 작품 안의 별도 구간입니다. 새로운 후속작의 기능이 늘었다는 증거로 쓰지는 않습니다. 공통으로 남길 활동과 달라질 조건을 따로 적어야 한다는 글쓰기 연습으로 이어가 보죠.
paragraphs.en: All of these comparisons use separate intervals within the second game. They are not evidence that a later installment added new features. Let us connect these observations to our writing exercise: state the activity to retain separately from the conditions to change.
paragraphs.claim: Same-game observations support our distinction between retained activity and changed conditions, not an internal developer pitch or sequel-feature claim.
paragraphs.viewerFocus: Keep watching the player aiming beside the devices; the following white diagram will turn that observed activity into our retained/change exercise.

reviewNote: All four independent KO/EN paragraphs directly compared with the19 new native boards and the limits of the existing OMD2/OMD3/Deathtrap concept. The four-sentence overview still promises observed core activities, changed choices and a check of one's concept. This insert supplies another observation before the retained/change explanation, without adding an unfulfilled overview promise. Phrases about our exercise are proposals; footage is not developer-internal evidence. Final word/cut timing must be measured before adoption.
